items.title: Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) Lands IndiGo Deal For 810 Airbus A320neo Family Jets
items.summary: IndiGo has selected Honeywell Aerospace to supply avionics and auxiliary power units for 810 Airbus A320neo-family aircraft. The agreement covers equipment and long-term aftermarket support for what is described as the largest such deal in Honeywell Aerospace’s history. This contract expands Honeywell Aerospace’s role within IndiGo’s fleet plans and adds scale to its commercial aviation equipment and services portfolio. items.summary: Honeywell Aerospace stock has retreated sharply over the past month, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiple checks still point to the shares trading at a discount to what the business may be worth.
